name: markdown-toc-sidebar
description: Shows a table of contents sidebar inside the built-in Markdown preview.

enumDescriptions: Animate the scroll to the heading.
markdownTocSidebar.scrollBehavior.markdownDescription: How the preview scrolls when you click an entry in the table of contents. When your system is set to reduce motion, the preview always jumps instantly.

enumDescriptions: Show the sidebar on the right side of the preview.
Show the sidebar on the left side of the preview.
markdownTocSidebar.position.markdownDescription: Which side of the preview the table of contents sidebar is shown on.

markdownTocSidebar.maxDepth.markdownDescription: The deepest heading level listed in the table of contents. The document's top level is always listed, even when it's deeper than this.

enumDescriptions: List it as the first entry, with the other headings nested under it.
Show it as a title under the sidebar's header, with the other headings listed from the top level.
markdownTocSidebar.topHeading.markdownDescription: How to show a document's single top heading, such as a `#` title above `##` sections. Only applies when the first heading is the only one at the document's top level.
